runtime.command_template: python tools/baywatch_harness.py --library <pinned-pinmame64.dll> --game baywatch --rom-path <authorized-existing-rom-root> --work-dir <new-empty-state-directory> --boot-wait <raw_run.boot_wait_s> --handle-mechanics 0 --scenario <raw_run.scenario_path> --dmd-dir <external-run-dmd> --output <external-run.json>. Keyboard handling off; binary solenoid mode. Original runs used the retained probe_harness.py adapter; its SHA256, the base harness SHA256 and exact ROM members are pinned in tools/baywatch_runtime_readings.json (SHA256 9a3998864663ee58e216e56c286846b2bd6785e326aaf9ff38d7607f0915edb1). The committed adapter has equivalent verified masks. Failed explorations remain in the external manifest and are excluded from successful raw_runs and causal observations.
